title: Void Infuser
text: Place a Void Crystal Ball at the center of an Assembly Table, with one High-Density Void Mass and three Repaired Mechanical Components in any outer positions.

Each operation takes ten seconds and one spatial energy, with a capacity of 64. Rough Spatial Crystal Blocks, excited blocks, Spatial Crystals and Deflection Crystals provide 1, 2, 4 and 6 energy respectively.

Infuse Mirror Rock into Void-Infested Mirror Rock, Light Condensate into Shadow Rock, slime balls into ender pearls and obsidian into crying obsidian. All temporal silts become rotted, and all saplings become Shadow Saplings.
